title: session grace-period and adaptive retry-weighting across Py/TS/Go SDKs
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: address two customer-visible mismatches across SDKs: 1) session token grace/TTL handling caused transient 401s during small clock skew and rapid handoffs, and 2) inconsistent retry weighting for streaming vs request/response calls resulted in uneven load on connector pools. This PR implements a lightweight session-grace window, normalizes TTL refresh semantics, and introduces an adaptive retry-weight multiplier for streaming consumers so retries do not hammer the connector during backoff storms. Changes span Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs and include tests, examples, and a minor version bump for each SDK. Checklist: - [x] implement session grace window (py/ts/go) - [x] unify TTL refresh path and prioritize background refresh - [x] add adaptive retry-weight multiplier (configurable) - [x] add integration test harness for race scenario - [x] update README and changelogs - [x] bump package versions (py:1.18.0, ts:2.7.1, go:1.5.3) Related work: Linear ENG-4129, ENG-4187. This description is an overview of the intent, implementation details and rollout notes are in commits and file diffs below.
commits: feat(session): add grace window and background refresh in token manager
fix(stream): apply adaptive retry-weighting to chunked consumers
test(integration): add race scenario for token handoff and streaming backoff
chore(release): bump py/ts/go sdk versions and changelogs

release_notes: SDKs: Introduce session grace-period to reduce transient auth failures during token handoffs; unify TTL refresh semantics across SDKs; add adaptive retry-weighting for streaming consumers to reduce connector pressure during retry storms. Breaking changes: none; configuration: new optional parameter session_grace_ms and retry_weight_multiplier available in SDK configs.
notes: Rollout plan: 1) packaged releases pushed to registries; 2) feature flagged default behavior (session_grace_ms=250ms, retry_weight_multiplier=0.6) to allow customer opt-out; 3) monitor token_refresh_start/complete and stream_retry_rate dashboards for 72 hours post-release.
